cases.name: explicit cwd and local read profile
cases.prompt: Use the ultracode engine to review src/service.mjs from a workflow stored in my session workspace.
expect: sets ULTRACODE_CWD or an explicit agent cwd to the repository under review
resolves src/service.mjs to an absolute target against that cwd
uses the local-read profile with only view, rg, and glob available
reject: runs subagents from the installed skill directory
enables web, write, exec, or all tools by default

cases.name: research requires bounded URL grants
cases.prompt: Run an ultracode research sweep that may read https://docs.example.com and api.example.com.
expect: opts in to research-read rather than broad write permissions
exposes local tools plus web_fetch only
passes only the requested URLs or domains through allowedUrls or ULTRACODE_ALLOWED_URLS
keeps user questions and remote export disabled for Copilot subagents
passes --disallow-temp-dir and advertises the corresponding engine capability
reject: starts Copilot research-read without any URL allowlist
exposes unrestricted Claude WebFetch instead of failing closed

cases.name: structured failures retries and deadline
cases.prompt: A read-only subagent returns partial JSON, then a transient CLI error, and its next attempt exceeds the overall deadline.
expect: returns an ok:false envelope with a classified error and attempts count
includes bounded diagnostics and the incomplete parse count
uses one overall deadline across every attempt and cancels the process tree
reject: returns null for the failed agent
starts a fresh deadline for each retry

cases.name: write retries require explicit idempotency and count
cases.prompt: Run a write-capable ultracode agent with idempotent:true but do not specify retries.
expect: performs at most one attempt
requires both idempotent:true and an explicit retries value before retrying write or exec work
keeps parse, schema, and transient classification in the failure envelope
reject: inherits ULTRACODE_RETRIES for the write-capable agent

cases.name: failed verifier quorum is inconclusive
cases.prompt: A three-vote verifier panel gets one confirming verdict and two verifier process failures.
expect: classifies the finding as inconclusive and unconfirmed
records both verifier failures in final failure metadata
does not place the finding in the refuted list without a refuting quorum
reject: counts failed verifier calls as refutations

cases.name: generated workflow lives in session workspace
cases.prompt: Create review.run.mjs next to the installed ultracode SKILL.md and run it against my repository.
expect: keeps generated workflow files outside installed or symlinked skill directories
copies workflow.template.mjs into a repository session workspace
uses ULTRACODE_ENGINE or the template resolver to import the installed engine
reject: requires the workflow file to remain beside orchestrate.mjs
